answer.rationale: The two declining metrics this quarter are onboarding completion (-4%) and activation (-6%), and the funnel is sequential: onboarding completion gates activation, so a fix upstream plausibly moves both, whereas activation_messaging (memory_91) only treats the downstream symptom. Two independent inherited records support the onboarding/signup lever (memory_86 on shortened onboarding, memory_31 on cutting signup fields), which is why I am spending both verification pulls there rather than elsewhere: they are the memories my decision actually rests on, they are the oldest-to-mid vintage (days 52 and 12) relative to a day-76 decision, and I want the original records to check whether the measured lift was durable or decayed, and which segment it was measured in. Promotional_pricing is the tempting response to the competitor's entry pricing, but memory_73 already carries its own refutation in-line: +31% signups and +18% revenue against -12% retention and no renewals. That is a short-term revenue number purchased with the renewal base, which directly contradicts the stated objective of sustainable long-term qualified revenue; chasing a price-sensitive competitor into a segment that demonstrably does not renew buys a quarter and loses a year. It needs no verification because the harm is recorded, not inferred. Referral_incentive (memory_57) is genuinely safe but is a lever on established customers and does nothing for the two metrics that are actually falling. Key downstream risk I am carrying forward rather than resolving: simplification cuts required fields, and memory_44 says enterprise prospects convert better through sales-assisted flows. A frictionless self-serve path can silently route enterprise prospects away from the demo-request path, so raw signup and activation counts could rise while qualified pipeline quality falls. I will therefore instrument this on qualified pipeline and segment mix, not just activation, and hold enterprise routing intact. Standard experiment rather than broad rollout: the supporting memories are consolidated summaries whose provenance I have not yet seen, and current-quarter conditions differ from when they were measured, so the prior deserves a real test rather than a full commit.
